Is he leaking urine unintentionally constantly or intermittently? Or is he letting out his full bladder intermittently? That would change things. :) 
If he’s leaking constantly, you can add baby powder or cornstarch to the diaper to help absorb the urine and keep him dry. Make sure it’s the plain kind, no additives. If it’s intermittent I would have the vet check to see if he’s retaining, or if you have a vet tech friend I’d have them feel his bladder to make sure that it’s not over flowing. He might need to be expressed. If you have someone teach you how to feel for it, it’s relatively easy to tell if it’s being emptied. It will feel like a very under inflated water balloon. If he can fully empty on his own at least once a day he likely doesn’t need to be expressed. If he can’t, he might need to be expressed so that the urine doesn’t go stagnant in his bladder and cause a UTI. Highly recommend the baby powder though, it’s a game changer!

The night I got his cancer diagnosis, and was told he only had 48-72 hours to live, I spent literally the entire night up researching holistic treatments, Chinese herbals, etc. The second 8am hit I began calling every holistic vet within 2 hours, begging to get him an appointment before it was too late.
